requirements.evidence: app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:30-36 locks and re-reads the queue before checking is_active; :42-68 selects waiting tickets, locks the candidate and re-checks its status; :79-94 implements queue/status filters, all three modes and priority/issued_at/id ordering; :102-118 implements the 3-call fairness window; :62-65 sets status, called_at and called_by_user_id and returns the ticket. app/Enums/CallMode.php:5-9 and app/Exceptions/NoWaitingTicketsException.php:7 match the contract in task.md:55-62.

conventions.evidence: The domain write is an invokable action in app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php (conventions.md:42-45) with feature tests in tests/Feature/CallNextTicketTest.php; docs/business-rules.md ('Ordering and Fairness', 'Call Panel') and docs/architecture.md ('Call the next ticket') are updated, and CHANGELOG.md:12 records the change. No migration/model changes are needed.

security.evidence: No HTTP/Livewire surface and no authorization, matching task.md:11-12. Query-builder predicates keep selection within the queue (CallNextTicket.php:79-81), the candidate status is re-checked under lock (:51-60), and only the three domain fields are assigned (:62-65); no raw SQL, secrets or output handling.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/CallNextTicketTest.php:38-263 covers ordering, all modes, fairness history/queue scoping, inactive/stale queue, empty/mode-specific failures and a simulated Ticket::call race (:240-263). However :60-75 never asserts the write-once invariant, and the fairness-history tests at :194-203 and :216-226 do not exercise normal_only history or the id tie-break direction.

simplicity.evidence: One focused action with two small private helpers (CallNextTicket.php:77-119); the skip loop exists only for the exactly-once requirement, and there is no service/repository layer or speculative abstraction.

readability.evidence: Clear names (candidates, mustServeNormal, FAIRNESS_STREAK), small methods, and useful comments at CallNextTicket.php:29 and :50; formatting is consistent Laravel/Pint style.

scope.evidence: The diff only adds the action, enum and exception, their test, the two required docs and the changelog entry; there are no unrelated refactors or features.

issues.explanation: The persistence test asserts the three updated fields but never checks that other ticket attributes such as priority, issued_at and queue_id stay unchanged, so the explicit write-once requirement in task.md:48-49 is not covered.

The test named 'resets the streak after a normal call, including normal_only calls' seeds a called normal ticket instead of invoking CallMode::NormalOnly, so it does not verify that a real normal_only call is recorded in the fairness history.

The called_at tie-break test places the only normal ticket at an older timestamp, so the last three calls are the three priority tickets whether id is sorted ascending or descending; the id tie-break direction is never actually exercised.

review.summary: The change adds the CallNextTicket action, CallMode enum and NoWaitingTicketsException, implementing deterministic ordering, all three modes, the 3-call fairness rule, queue/ticket locking and inactive-queue rejection, with extensive feature tests and updated documentation. The implementation and scope are strong and the pull request is approvable, but the test suite does not assert the write-once invariant and has a few fairness-history cases that are described but not actually exercised.
